facts.fact: ANSI, the national information society agency, designed SIGEPAP-GNN, the personnel, postings and pensions system of the National Guard, presented on 23 April 2025 under an ANSI-National Guard memorandum of August 2024.
ANSI's technical teams designed and developed SIGEPAP-GNN, which was presented and handed to the National Guard on 23 April 2025 and is described as deployed.

systems.country_label: Systeme Integre de Gestion du personnel, des affectations et des pensions de la Garde Nationale

systems.owner: National Guard of Niger; designed by ANSI

NER.note: SIGEPAP-GNN is the National Guard's own personnel and pensions system, not central government payroll.
Sovereignty is claimed for one military system; no strategy, rule, national hosting or contract term is stated.
